game.name: Connect Four
game.description: Choose a column to drop a disc. Connect four horizontally, vertically or diagonally. A full board is a draw.

strings.draw: Draw: no four in a row
strings.goal: Connect four in a row. Drag the disc to a column, or tap a column.
strings.title: Connect Four

game.game_logic_rules:
Two players alternate on a board of six rows and seven columns. Player 1 uses yellow discs marked 1; player 2 uses red discs marked 2. Player 1 starts.

On your turn, choose any column that is not full. One disc drops to the lowest empty space in that column. You cannot move or remove discs already placed.

The first player with at least four of their own discs in an unbroken horizontal, vertical or diagonal line wins immediately. A full board with no winning line is a draw.
game.game_ui_rules: Drag the reserve disc to a highlighted column, or tap a highlighted column directly. Placed discs are read only. Use the platform camera to zoom and pan; history and spectators cannot play.

game.name: Checkers (Declarative)
game.description: Move diagonally, capture opposing pieces by jumping, and reach the far side to crown a king. Captures are mandatory and a capture chain must be completed.

strings.text_12: Move diagonally; kings move either direction.

strings.title: Checkers (Declarative)

game.game_logic_rules: Move diagonally, capture opposing pieces by jumping, and reach the far side to crown a king. Captures are mandatory and a capture chain must be completed.
game.game_ui_rules: Select a highlighted piece, then tap its legal destination. Crowns, required captures, and continuing jumps are shown from the server view.
